messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy blocked for release v3.14.0

deploy-bot: Reason: base image digest parity failure between staging and prod for gcr.io/redwood/runtime-base:3.2.x

deploy-bot: Staging image: gcr.io/redwood/runtime-base:3.2.0@sha256:abcd1234ef567890

deploy-bot: Prod image:    gcr.io/redwood/runtime-base:3.2.1@sha256:efgh9876zyx54321

alex: huh, the build job should have recorded the digest. CI uses tag->digest resolution during bake though.

maria: CI pipeline used the tag `:3.2.0` and baked the digest at 2026-03-19T22:37Z. Prod cluster pulled `:3.2.1` after the base-image auto-patch landed yesterday.

sam: we should pin the release artifact to the digest in the helm chart and re-run canary. Two options: (1) pin to staging digest and redeploy prod, or (2) roll prod back to prior digest.

jules: agree. I'll update charts/releases/runtime-base.image to use `@sha256:abcd1234ef567890` and trigger a canary redeploy now.

katie-rc: hold release window until canary is healthy. If canary fails, we block promotion and open an incident.

maria: ticket INF-3245 created: "pin runtime-base digest in release artifacts + stop relying on floating tags". Also added note to release notes: "base image digest pinned due to prod/staging parity mismatch".

sam: quick diagnostics commands for reference: `gcloud container images describe gcr.io/redwood/runtime-base:3.2.0 --format='get(image_summary.digest)'` and `docker pull gcr.io/redwood/runtime-base@sha256:abcd1234ef567890`

jules: canary redeploy started — kube rollout status looks fine so far. ETA 12m.

deploy-bot: Release status: paused -> awaiting canary healthy. Reaction: :hourglass:
